# VOUT Cargo — Global Freight & Import Operations System

> Autonomous logistics platform for international container tracking, customs clearance dispatching, quote estimation, and fleet finance auditing. Developed by Agustín Milesi.

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)
- **Database & ORM**: PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM
- **Visual Design**: Obsidian Dark theme (`#0A0E14`) with Dynamic Accent system (Cyber Lime `#C6F827`, Emerald, Indigo, Rose, Amber, Cyan, Violet)
- **Deployment**: Vercel Serverless Edge (Live at https://cargo-am.vercel.app)
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliant (skip-to-content, ARIA labels, semantic landmark roles)

## Core Capabilities
- **Real-Time Container Tracking**: Multi-carrier shipment lookup with interactive milestone progression and ETA recalculation.
- **Quote Matrix**: Land, air, and ocean freight rate calculator with margin estimation.
- **Client & Dispatch Directory**: Importers, exporters, customs brokers, and forwarders registry.
- **Logistics Ledger**: Freight expenses breakdown (fuel, tolls, port handling, resting) and gross profitability analytics.
- **Customer Portal**: Public tracking interface for consignees without administrative login.

## Key Routes & Manifest
- Dashboard: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/
- Live Tracking: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/tracking
- Instant Quotes: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/quotes
- Shipments Index: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/shipments
- Client Directory: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/clients
- Finance Audit: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/finances
- Consignee Portal: https://cargo-am.vercel.app/portal
- Developer Contact & Hub: https://agustinmilesi-contact.vercel.app
